title: TinyPhaseNet: code, trained models and device measurements for a depthwise separable seismic phase picker compressed for TinyML
description:
Code, trained models (seeds 42, 43 and 44, Keras and TensorFlow Lite), ESP32-S3 firmware with a replacement transposed-convolution kernel, result files, and the analysis scripts that derive the results of two manuscripts on post-training quantization and depthwise separable convolution of a seismic phase picker (TinyPhaseNet) and its standard-convolution counterpart (PhaseNet). No waveform is redistributed: STEAD, INSTANCE, ETHZ and TXED must be obtained from their original sources (see data/README.md).
